paragraphs: See the entry R' Huna bar R' Chalutz.[^1]

notes.text: The heading explicitly has Rav Huna bar Chiyun. The pointer abbreviates ר״ה, contextually read as Huna, and בר׳ before Chalutz. Its two personal titles remain unresolved as R'; the distinct Chiyun/Chalutz spellings are retained. The earlier heading-based Rav expansion is preserved as an inference rather than exact target evidence.
